on_accept.note: Illustrative on_accept only — RV-3 (on_accept adapter) owns what this shape actually means and is the card that files it. Nothing acts on this seed.

verdict.note: SEED (RV-1). The dev-qc lane: a dev artifact judged by two named reviewers. This request is deliberately on the EXPLICIT half of the close rule — two reviewers AND an `on_accept` — so it never auto-closes and the surface must label it as waiting on an explicit close from the requester or owner. It is the counterpart to the email-sends seed, which is the auto-close half; between them the two branches of the close rule are both exercised by a real record.
